verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are possible only indirectly. The Plugin API gives read/write access to create and modify file contents and is pitched for automating tasks. The Variables REST API supports creating, updating and deleting variables, and the MCP server can write to the canvas. A community user notes bulk export depends on a third-party plugin, while another complains about exporting icons one at a time. Missing for 10: a documented native multi-item bulk-edit capability, explicit batch semantics in the APIs/MCP tools, and hands-on corroboration of AI-driven bulk changes across many items.
